purpose: Evidence baseline for Phase 6 operator, valet, monthly, event, and airport parser/source discovery before partnerships.

sources.evidence_claim: ABM describes more than 2,000 parking locations in more than 230 cities and direct booking/rates on its public site.
Metropolis describes itself as the largest US parking operator, with thousands of North American locations and verticals including hospitality, aviation, healthcare, universities, and events/venues.

Parking.com exposes city and facility-style pages for daily and monthly parking; SP+ corporate pages also list valet, hospitality, airports, healthcare, universities, and events/venues as relevant operating verticals.
AirportParking.com describes airport parking comparison/reservation coverage across many airports with prices, distance, shuttle information, and services.
Platinum Parking describes managed parking across US cities and public monthly parking discovery.

research_note: These sources are not treated as master data until parser specs, evidence capture, legal/ToS review, and dedupe rules are written. They are high-priority candidates because city open data alone cannot cover private garages/lots, valet, monthly, airport, venue, event, and operator-managed inventory.
